The company reports that its tracpoint web-based vehicle tracking platform integrates with a variety of tracking hardware across multiple wireless networks, including both satellite and terrestrial cellular networks.
The company reports that its tracpoint software offers a lightweight version, Tracpoint Flash, which is optimized to deliver telematics data and maps over low-bandwidth or VSAT satellite connections.

The company reports active deployment of its Tracpoint fleet tracking and maintenance system with international humanitarian organisations such as Oxfam, which utilises the platform across its global field bases to track asset registers and fleet movements.

The company has established a strategic partnership with Toyota Gibraltar Stockholdings to integrate vehicle procurement with driver training, telematics, and fleet management software deployed globally on the Tracpoint platform.
